report.summary: Consolidated verified findings from containment.py and worktree.py. 4 actionable items prioritized by blast radius: missing GitWorktreeManager (critical), reparse point traversal (security), ValueError propagation (stability), debug log loss (observability). 1 undecidable risk about job config verification.

risks.finding: UNDECIDABLE: _verify_job_config may not check ActiveProcessLimit and JobMemoryLimit; implementation not in provided excerpt.

todos.action: Implement GitWorktreeManager and cleanup_worktree with allocation record integrity and identity checks.
todos.trigger: Absence of implementation makes containment claims unverified.

todos.action: Fix _is_reparse_point to fail closed on OSError/ValueError; return True or re-raise instead of swallowing exception.
todos.trigger: OSError/ValueError during stat on a reparse point.
todos.impact: Security: silent traversal into reparse points, bypassing containment.

todos.action: Document or wrap _chain_between callers to convert ValueError to WorktreeContainmentError when target not under root.
todos.trigger: target not under root causes ValueError.
todos.impact: Stability: unhandled exception may crash the program if containment invariant is broken.

todos.action: Replace undefined _log_as_hex with _log_hex in _create_process or define _log_as_hex.
todos.trigger: Call to _log_as_hex raises NameError, silently caught by bare except.
todos.impact: Observability: debug logs are lost, hindering diagnostics.
